mapper.sql: w.workdirect_id AS workdirectId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, w.workdt_no AS workdtNo, TO_CHAR(w.workdt_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS workdtDate, w.material_id AS materialId, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, TO_CHAR(w.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prodPlanDate, TO_CHAR(w.expiration_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expirationDate, w.prodplan_qty AS prodplanQty, w.prod_memo AS prodMemo

WHERE w.use_at = 'Y'
AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}
AND w.prod_plan_date >= CAST(#{startDate} AS date)
AND w.prod_plan_date <= CAST(#{endDate} AS date)
AND LOWER(m.material_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY w.workdt_no DESC) AS rn FROM tb_workdirect w JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = w.material_id AND m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id
) work_order_query WHERE rn BETWEEN #{firstIndex} AND #{lastIndex} ORDER BY rn
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_workdirect w JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = w.material_id AND m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id

SELECT
FROM tb_workdirect w JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = w.material_id AND m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE w.workdirect_id = #{workdirectId} AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.use_at = 'Y'
SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{value} LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(workdt_no) FROM tb_workdirect WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND workdt_no LIKE #{datePrefix} || '%'

INSERT INTO tb_workdirect ( tenant_id, workdt_no, workdt_date, prod_plan_date, material_id, expiration_date, prodplan_qty, prod_memo, use_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{workdtNo}, CAST(#{workdtDate} AS date), CAST(#{prodPlanDate} AS date), #{materialId}, CAST(#{expirationDate} AS date), #{prodplanQty}, #{prodMemo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING workdirect_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_workdirect SET material_id = #{materialId}, prod_plan_date = CAST(#{prodPlanDate} AS date), expiration_date = CAST(#{expirationDate} AS date), prodplan_qty = #{prodplanQty}, prod_memo = #{prodMemo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workdirect_id = #{workdirectId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND use_at = 'Y'
UPDATE tb_workdirect SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workdirect_id = #{workdirectId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND use_at = 'Y'
